resolutions.researcher_notes: DO NOT confirm the wiki's suggested 54%/46% JV attribution (江西省天然气管道有限公司). Per the 2022 CCXI/中诚信 credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团 (pdftotext-extracted from qxb-pdf-osscache.qixin.com/AnBaseinfo/85599868a5a6e3c2fc8db704da8180b8.pdf -- url_verifier flags the raw PDF bytes as not containing the string because it does not extract embedded/scanned text, but pdftotext -layout confirms it verbatim; hand-confirmed false negative per verification policy), Jiangxi runs TWO separate provincial gas operators: 天然气管道公司 (the 54%/46% JV) operates ONLY Phase I (川气东送-sourced network); 管道分公司 (an internal division the Group itself formed in early 2016, no JV/no PipeChina stake) operates Phase II (西气东输-sourced network, ~1,500km across 40 counties incl. Dayu). This row is explicitly labeled Phase II in segment_name. Independently corroborated by the quannan.gov.cn emergency plan itself (Table 3-1, 运行单位 = 江西省天然气集团有限公司 -- the parent Group, not the JV subsidiary) -- two distinct hosts. Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than staging a corrected value, since the exact Operator string (Group vs its internal 管道分公司 division) needs a human call on which entity name the sheet wants; see __VALIDITY__.

resolutions.researcher_notes: New source this pass: the quannan.gov.cn emergency-response plan for the Ganzhou South branch bundle (江西省天然气管网工程赣州南（信丰-瑞金段）等4条支线突发环境事件风险评估报告, a 321-page official government-commissioned PDF covering all 4 branches incl. this one by name) states: '江西省天然气（赣投气通）控股有限公司于2017年11月委托陕西中圣环境科技发展有限公司编制完成《江西省天然气管网工程赣州南（信丰-瑞金段）等4条支线项目环境影响报告书》，并报送赣州市环境保护局审批。赣州市环境保护局于2017年12月28日下达...（赣市环审字[2017]116号）' -- i.e. the EIA covering this exact segment (named in the report's own title alongside its 3 siblings) was formally approved 2017-12-28. Environmental approval directly preceding a construction start is the normal sequence for Chinese pipeline projects, and Dec-2017 approval clearing the way for a 2018 construction start is consistent with (though not an exact literal restatement of) the sheet's staged ConstructionYear=2018. Held at medium/single-document/not independent because the connection between 'EIA approved Dec 2017' and 'construction began 2018' is inferential, not a literal 'construction began in 2018' statement -- and because this is an aggregate 4-branch EIA approval, not a segment-exclusive one (though the approval date itself is a single shared regulatory event that necessarily applies to all 4 branches equally). url_verifier reports FAIL/HTTP 403 on this URL (quannan.gov.cn WAF blocks the verifier's plain request); hand-confirmed via a cookie-jar bypass (curl -c cookies.txt <homepage>, then -b/-c cookies.txt on the PDF URL, HTTP 200) + pdftotext -layout extraction (11,643 lines) -- encoding this as a hand-confirmed false negative per the standing verification-policy exception (ok:true/contains_value:true + note).
